subject: Arcturus RFI: control orchestration & evidence sprint
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arcturus-consulting.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinf.com
Cc: procure@arcturus-consulting.com
Date: 2027-12-19 09:12 PST
Subject: RFI: SIG questionnaire — control mapping and artifact cadence

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The procurement and infosec teams at Arcturus are moving quickly — attached is our trimmed SIG questionnaire v3.0. Two asks: 1) can Redwood provide a control-to-evidence mapping (we need file-level artifacts for our auditors), and 2) what cadence can you commit to for delivering outstanding artifacts during our evaluation sprint (we're planning a three-week window)?

Please include owner names for each artifact and indicate if evidence is redacted or sensitive. Also flag any controls where you require third-party attestations or where the control is out-of-scope.

Can you get an initial mapping back by EOD Tuesday PST? Procurement will follow up on contract timing once we see the mapping.

Best,
Lena
Vendor Risk Manager
Arcturus Consulting

Attachments: Arcturus_SIG_v3_trimmed.xlsx (questionnaire)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinf.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arcturus-consulting.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinf.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinf.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinf.com
Date: 2027-12-19 10:05 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire — control mapping and artifact cadence

Lena — thanks for the note and the trimmed questionnaire. We can do the initial control-to-evidence mapping by EOD Tuesday. High-level plan:

- Today (Mon): intake and triage. Marissa will own artifact collection and point us to owners for infra/app controls.
- Tue morning: internal review and populate mapping spreadsheet; Tue EOD: deliver mapping + index of available artifacts.
- Week 1 of your sprint: prioritized delivery of high-value artifacts (SOC 2 report, key procedures).
- Week 2: deeper control substantiation (network diagrams, access logs) with sensitivity/redaction guidance.
- Week 3: remaining artifacts and runbook for auditors for any follow-ups.

I've attached a starter mapping and our current SOC 2 Type II report for context. We'll flag controls that require third-party proof (e.g., cloud provider change-management attestations).

Action items for Arcturus to help us prioritize: highlight top 12 in-scope controls and any deadline constraints.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Mapping_v1.xlsx; SOC2-Type2-Report-2027.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinf.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinf.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinf.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinf.com
Date: 2027-12-19 11:18 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire — control mapping and artifact cadence

Looping in artifact owners and tracking cadence. I'll create an evidence backlog in the shared Drive and assign owners. Quick notes:

- I’ll take ownership of Change Management (control group CM and PRIM). Can provide policy, change ticket export, and quarterly review notes.
- Neha — will you own SOC 2 attestations and encryption key lifecycle docs?
- Vanessa — can you pull application deployment diagrams and CI/CD pipeline controls (artifact: deployment-manifest.zip stub)?

I'll add ETA columns in the mapping sheet and mark anything that requires redaction. I'll also add a column for the evidentiary format (PDF, CSV, log extract).

Marissa
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwoodinf.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arcturus-consulting.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwoodinf.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinf.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinf.com
Date: 2027-12-19 13:02 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire — control mapping and artifact cadence

Hi Lena — attaching our SOC 2 Type II report and an evidence index CSV that maps report sections to SIG families. For controls where logs are required, we can provide time-bounded extracts (redacted PII). For cryptographic key procedures, we can provide KMS policy redacted for customer-specific keys.

Two clarifications we need from Arcturus before full exports:
1) Do you need raw syslog exports or summarized alert reports? Raw logs require a limited transfer scope and are slower to produce.
2) Which auditors (firm) will be reviewing artifacts — if they require direct ingestion we can provision a temporary secure share.

I've added comments to the mapping spreadsheet with these questions.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-Report-2027.pdf; evidence-index-arc-2027.csv
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arcturus-consulting.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinf.com
Cc: procure@arcturus-consulting.com
Date: 2027-12-19 15:10 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire — control mapping and artifact cadence

Thanks all — this is great. Quick answers:
- Auditor firm is Copley & Partners; they prefer summarized alert reports initially; raw log access will only be requested if gaps appear.
- For the 12 priority controls, see inline comments on your mapping (we flagged PRIM-2, ACC-4, INF-5, and CRY-1 as top priority).
- We will need KMS policy redactions to omit customer-specific key identifiers. Summarized alert reports are acceptable for now.

Can you confirm estimated delivery time for the prioritized artifacts (SOC 2 is already there, thank you) and whether you can create a secure, read-only Drive share for Copley? Procurement also needs to see the proposed evidence transfer method for their legal checklist (SFTP vs secure Drive link).

Best,
Lena
From: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinf.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arcturus-consulting.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinf.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinf.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinf.com, procure@arcturus-consulting.com
Date: 2027-12-19 17:04 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire — control mapping and artifact cadence

Lena — confirmed. Delivery estimates for the flagged priority artifacts:

- PRIM-2 (proof of identity verification workflow): ETA Tue EOD (mapping cell linked).
- ACC-4 (access review exports): ETA Wed COB; will provide CSV export of reviewer actions and summary reports.
- INF-5 (network segmentation diagram + firewall rule snapshot): ETA Wed EOD; diagram PDF + rule export stub.
- CRY-1 (KMS policy + key lifecycle procedure redacted): ETA Thu EOD (redaction required).

We will provision a secure, read-only Drive folder for Copley & Partners and provide a short-lived link (restricted to their corporate domains). For procurement: we can support either secure Drive or SFTP; recommended default is Drive share with strict domain restrictions and additional short-lived signed links for any raw logs. I’ll add the transfer method summary to the mapping sheet and the HubSpot record (HS-34902).

Next steps: I’ll upload the updated mapping with ETA columns and a checklist (evidence-index-arc-2027.csv) by Tue morning. If procurement needs a formal Data Transfer Agreement for raw logs, loop legal and we’ll expedite.

Thanks — Mateo
--- End of thread ---
